highlights:
United States vs Paraguay prediction: the hosts win this, backed by home-crowd advantage, superior squad depth and a head-to-head record that favors the Americans. At +100 betting odds on BetOnline, the United States represent genuine value for a side that has won three of its last five, including a 2-1 defeat of Paraguay just seven months ago on this same fixture.
[...]
Paraguay, under Argentine coach Gustavo Alfaro, arrive as compact, disciplined opponents whose CONMEBOL qualifying run — three wins, two draws and one defeat across six fixtures — suggests a side capable of grinding results. Their model is pragmatic: a settled back four, a disciplined mid-block, and quick transitions through wide players and mobile forwards. They will not come to Los Angeles to exchange goals.
[...]
The match is likely decided in the middle third. If the United States can impose their high-press identity and deny Paraguay the chance to settle into their defensive shape, the attacking quality of Pulisic, Weston McKennie and Folarin Balogun should eventually tell. Paraguay’s best-case scenario involves weathering the early storm, staying compact and hitting space on the counter through Miguel Almirón and Julio Enciso.
[...]
Paraguay’s recent friendly run is two wins from five, with defeats to Morocco and South Korea alongside a creditable 1-0 win in Greece. The wins over Mexico and Greece point to a side capable of grinding out compact results; the losses suggest limited ceiling against physically aggressive opponents pressing with purpose. Their goal output across those five games is modest, reinforcing the picture of a team that relies on structure over creativity.
[...]
Main Pick: United States to Win @ +100 (BetOnline). The Americans have beaten Paraguay in their last three meetings including a 2-1 home win in November 2025. Playing at SoFi Stadium with a home crowd and the deeper squad, the United States are the correct favorites at an even-money price that reflects genuine market uncertainty without genuine on-field parity.
[...]

Four of the last five United States vs Paraguay meetings have produced at least two goals, and both sides have shown attacking intent in recent friendlies. The United States scored five against Uruguay and two against Paraguay last November; Paraguay scored in all three of their recent wins. The -138 line is short but backed by the historical pattern in this fixture.

USA vs Paraguay Prediction and Betting
[...]
World Cup co-hosts the USA get their tournament underway with a compelling Group D encounter against Paraguay at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood on Friday. This is the opening match for the two sides and the 10th time they have faced each other.
[...]
The United States of America are expected to do well as the host nation with the biggest claim to home advantage among the three co-hosts, as 78 games will take place in the USA, while Canada and Mexico will host 13 matches each.
[...]
Meanwhile, Paraguay return to the World Cup for the first time in 16 years, having finished sixth in the CONMEBOL qualification standings to claim the final automatic qualification spot.
[...]
La Albirroja chose to play only one friendly match in the last few weeks in preparation for the competition, but they secured that victory in style, beating Nicaragua 4-0 on 6 June.
[...]
Paraguay's goals came from Alejandro Romero Gamarra, Miguel Almiron, Matias Galarza, and Alexandro Maidana. That comfortable win will provide a boost of confidence to coach Gustavo Alfaro's players ahead of this opening encounter with the USA.
[...]
## USA vs Paraguay head-to-head stats and key numbers
[...]
- There have been nine matches between the USA and Paraguay, with the Stars and Stripes dominating the head-to-head record with five wins to two for La Albirroja.
- Before the draw for the 2026 World Cup was known (5 December 2025), Paraguay and the USA faced off in a friendly match in November 2025, with the Americans securing a 2-1 victory.
- Giovanni Reyna and Folarin Balogun scored for Pochettino's side, with Alex Arce on target for the South Americans.
- The USA are ranked 17th in the world, while Paraguay are 41st in the latest FIFA World Rankings.

## USA vs Paraguay prediction
[...]
The USA are likely to use their high-pressing, attacking system, which relies on the deadly pace of their forwards and wingers, such as Christian Pulisic, to break down the Paraguayan backline.
[...]
Pochettino's compact defense will need to look out for Paraguay's counterattacking menace, as they often score from such opportunities.
[...]
Star winger Julio Enciso may sit this match out due to a minor thigh issue, which would be a blow to Paraguay's attacking threat, but their defense has been their major strength under Alfaro, as his low-block defensive structure has been effective.

The Americans will look to make a statement in this first game, and with the home crowd willing them on, we expect the Stars and Stripes to secure a narrow win.
